# Is the low bid really the low bid once everyone is bidding the same scope?

> Free bid leveling worksheet: paste subcontractor bids, price the excluded and unaddressed scope at your estimate, and see whether the low bid is still lowest. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
